newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dollar ends firmer after quiet session.
newsitem.headline: Canada dollar ends firmer after quiet session.

text.p: * Canada's dollar ended slightly firmer in thin trade at C$1.3616 (US$0.7343) from Friday's close of C$1.3629 (US$0.7337). * Strengthened this morning after government posted positive real GDP. * Bank of Canada set three rounds of specials at 4.25 percent at top end of its 3.75-4.25 percent range for call loan. * Unit seen C$1.3610-C$1.3625 overnight.
Cieplucha said he expects the Bank of Canada may cut short-term interest rates when the dollar reaches C$1.3550 to ensure economic growth.

The unit firmed this morning after Statistics Canada said Canada's real gross domestic product rose 0.5 percent in July after remaining unchanged in June. The gain was a bit more than economists had expected.
Otherwise, "it really didn't do too much of anything," one trader said. The dollar closed at C$1.3616 (US$0.7343) from Friday's close of C$1.3629 (US$0.7337).
Overnight the unit is seen from C$1.3610-C$1.3625.
On the crosses the Canadian dollar rose to 1.1192 marks from Friday's close of 1.1181 marks and gained to 81.71 yen from 81.29 yen.
